EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Provider Quality Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.description: Define a strict response schema for provider quality snapshot including credential, specialty, license state, status, enumeration date, and address, with explicit typing, null-handling, and alignment to NPI field structures.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Provider Quality Mapping Logic from NPI Data
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.description: Extract and normalize NPI registry fields into the snapshot schema, including credential parsing, specialty normalization, license state mapping, enumeration date formatting, and deterministic handling of missing or inconsistent values.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Provider Quality Snapshot via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include provider quality snapshot in provider detail responses, enforcing schema contract consistency and compatibility with tool_router and downstream consumers.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.title: Render Provider Quality Snapshot in Chat UI
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.description: Display provider quality snapshot in the chat interface using structured label/value formatting, ensuring readability, consistent ordering of fields, and graceful handling of missing or partial data.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Quality Snapshot
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.description: Implement unit tests for schema validation and mapping logic, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from provider_detail_service through evaluate_care_facade, API response contract, and frontend rendering.
